verdict.rationale: The pack shows data export/import and an MCP design that avoids returning secrets to agents, but there is no evidence of explicit controls for data retention policies or deletion (e.g., audit-log retention settings, vault/item purge, GDPR-style deletion) tailored to AI-native workflows. missing for 10: retention policy controls, explicit deletion/purge mechanisms for AI-consumed data, documentation tying these to AI agent use.
